QuestInfo.name: The Tiger Daimyou
QuestInfo.0: Shingen and Yukimura are safe in Momijigaoka. Fill them in on what's happened.
QuestInfo.1: Shingen and Yukimura are safely back in Momijigaoka. It seems that Uesugi Kenshin and Naoe Kanetsugu also made it back. Tell them what has happened so far.
QuestInfo.2: The alliance is regaining its former strength since the two daimyou Shingen and Kenshin have made it to Momijigaoka. All you need now is a skilled leader.
